title: Turn Your Values into Time
coreMove: Translate a value from a belief into a protected block on the calendar that can be kept or renegotiated honestly.
sourcePressure: The chapter opens the traction section by converting values into visible time commitments, with timeboxing as more useful than list maintenance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would ask the reader to list priorities without forcing values to occupy actual time.

hook: Turn Your Values into Time as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: urban planner protecting field-walk time before permit reviews
exampleSpecs.audience: planner who claims neighborhood observation matters
exampleSpecs.stakes: plans drift from lived streets when field time stays aspirational
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she places a Tuesday sidewalk walk on the calendar before accepting another permit review
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A zoning map is folded under a field-walk pass.

exampleSpecs.domain: physical therapist making room for continuing education
exampleSpecs.audience: clinician who values skill but lets charting consume every evening
exampleSpecs.stakes: patients keep getting the same old protocol
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he blocks one anatomy review after lunch and closes the overflow chart stack
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An anatomy atlas is open beside a patient chart rack.

exampleSpecs.domain: neighborhood choir parent protecting rehearsal listening with a child
exampleSpecs.audience: parent who says music matters at home
exampleSpecs.stakes: connection becomes theory while evenings fill with errands
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she puts the fifteen-minute listening block before laundry pickup and sets out the song sheet
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A song sheet rests beside a small speaker on a hallway bench.

exampleSpecs.domain: independent mechanic planning training on hybrid systems
exampleSpecs.audience: mechanic whose value is staying useful as cars change
exampleSpecs.stakes: the shop loses future work if training never becomes time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, he saves course links; after, he blocks Friday diagnostic practice and rolls out one battery trainer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A battery trainer sits beside a grease-free notebook.

exampleSpecs.domain: immigration clinic director scheduling case review with volunteers
exampleSpecs.audience: director who values dignity but reacts only to emergencies
exampleSpecs.stakes: clients get inconsistent preparation without protected review time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she declines a vague networking lunch and books two case-review blocks with named files
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A visa file stack is tied with a red legal ribbon.

exampleSpecs.domain: ceremonial drum maker reserving quiet finishing time
exampleSpecs.audience: craftsperson who says finish quality is sacred
exampleSpecs.stakes: orders ship rough when interruptions own the afternoon
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes the finishing hour into the wall calendar and moves sanding calls outside it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A stretched drumhead dries beside a wall calendar page.
